# pixel-builder

> Vibe-code consistent pixel art for games: characters, buildings, trees and ground tiles, props and items, UI and tile maps, all generated from one Style Kit (palette ramps, one light direction, one outline mode) so everything matches. Drive it from any AI agent through an MCP server (stdio or Streamable HTTP) or a CLI, or use the web app. Procedural generators need no API key.

Agents making pixel art: read the skill first. Agents editing this repository: read AGENTS.md. The 16 tools have the same names in MCP and in the CLI (kebab-case commands, `--json`).

## Use it

- [Skill: pixel-builder (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder/blob/main/skills/pixel-builder/SKILL.md): when to use it, the vibe-code workflow, consistency rules, tool cheat-sheet, how to paint with the legend.
- [Skill reference](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder/blob/main/skills/pixel-builder/reference.md): legend characters, kit fields, generator catalogue, export formats.
- [Integrations guide](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder/blob/main/docs/integrations.md): copy-paste setup for Claude Code, Hermes Agent, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, VS Code / Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, OpenAI Agents SDK, remote MCP (HTTP) and plain shell agents.

## Work on it

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, layout, consistency model, working rules.
- [Build plan](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder/blob/main/docs/BUILD_PLAN.md): architecture, file ownership, the agent tool contract.

## Quick start

- Launch (stdio MCP, inside the repo): `npx tsx src/node/cli.ts mcp`
- Launch (Streamable HTTP): `npx tsx src/node/cli.ts mcp --http --port 8788` then `http://127.0.0.1:8788/mcp`
- CLI: `npx tsx src/node/cli.ts <command> --json` (for example `get-style-guide`, `list-generators`, `generate-asset`)
- Workspace: `--workspace <dir>` or env `PIXEL_BUILDER_WORKSPACE` (default `./pixel-assets`), or a shared-server URL `http(s)://host/api/projects/<id>` (token env `PIXEL_BUILDER_TOKEN`, exports to `--out-dir`/`PIXEL_BUILDER_OUT_DIR`); exports in `<workspace>/characters|buildings|environments|objects|ui|maps/`

## Tools (MCP tool names)

get_style_guide, list_generators, generate_asset, generate_variations, paint_asset, edit_asset, edit_region (change only a rect or cells region with your own legend rows, or a prompt when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set), list_assets, get_asset, delete_asset, export_asset (png/spritesheet/tiled/svg/aseprite/tiled-tileset/godot/unity/atlas), import_image, import_svg, list_kits, create_kit, update_kit (locked kits are refused: fork with create_kit), set_active_kit, rerender_assets (stale_only), list_rigs, list_clips, list_attachments, generate_rigged (directions 4|8), attach, create_rig, create_clip, create_attachment, generate_pack (built-in farming-v1 starter kit, iso-starter, monsters-v1 (rigs monster-mushroom-red/brown/poison/king, monster-slime-green/blue/fire/metal, monster-plant, monster-bat, monster-wolf, monster-skeleton with clips idle, walk, attack, hurt, die), or your own manifest). Kit presets: kit-default, kit-gameboy, kit-neon, kit-side (platformer camera: sideview/sideenemy/sidelevel generators, humanoid-side rig, pack side-view-starter), kit-iso (isometric 2:1 camera: iso-tile/iso-prop/iso-building/isomap generators, rows walk-se/sw/ne/nw, Tiled isometric export, pack iso-starter), kit-hd, kit-hd-rich and kit-hd-deep (HD = every size 1.5x, 48px characters; deep = 9-shade ramps, legend adds non-ASCII chars for the extra shades). Materials: 19 incl. `blossom` (pink; sakura trees, flowers accent), appended so existing indices/legend chars never change. MCP resources: pixel-builder://project, pixel-builder://style-guide. MCP prompts: asset_pack, design_creature (author a rigged creature yourself with create_rig / create_clip / create_attachment, no API key).

Custom motion: write the clip yourself and call create_clip with rig (no key needed). Poses are {joint:[dx,dy]} in grid units (y grows down), per-view frames {down,side,up} with equal counts, only the family's joints, offsets within +-4 (+-8 for jumps), feet kept on the ground. Worked example (wai bow) in skills/pixel-builder/SKILL.md. The web app's "Describe animation" box (POST /api/clip) does this with the server model.

The `ui` generator has an MMO HUD skin (`skin: mmo-gold|mmo-stone|mmo-dark`) with unit frames, glossy bars, minimap, skill bar with cooldown sweep, chat, quest tracker, tooltip, nameplate and damage numbers. Generators include rigged characters and animals, a Thai stilt house, corrugated roofs, a rice-paddy tile and a rice-village map biome. Characters take `pattern` (plaid, stripes, polka, gingham) and `expression` (happy, surprised, tired); rigged recipes can request a pattern with a part-less attachment id `pattern-<kind>[:slot]` (applied by `applyPattern` in `src/core/rigs/shapes-pattern.ts`).

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/GRITui/pixel-builder)
- Generator `foliage`: HD trees (params species oak|willow|maple-autumn|birch|fruit-tree|pine-hd|sakura, size small|medium|large, season spring|summer|fall|winter, leaf, accent, variant); rows idle + sway.

Water depth: environment water-tile depth 0-3 + shore/shore_rocks, props lily-pad, reeds, cattail, river-rock, driftwood, small-bridge (span 1-3); map water_depth / river; tileset lower_depth / upper_depth.
MMO forest: map biome forest-mmo (river with depth bands, path over a bridge, HD tree groves, grouped props, spawn points in meta.spawns, y-sorted meta.objects and a Tiled object layer), params detail off|low|medium|high (any biome, default off) and season mixed|spring|summer|fall; `npx tsx scripts/mmo-scene.ts` renders docs/img/mmo-scene.png.
